final: WITH base AS (SELECT st.healtheval AS status, s.scancount AS scancount, s.gbsize / s.spanmin AS ratio FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), g AS (SELECT status, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM base GROUP BY status) SELECT status, total_scans, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM g) AS deviation_from_mean FROM g WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM g) IS NOT NULL
